topic.title: System Requirements
topic.shortdesc: Details about the system requirements for using .

body.p: Before you start using , make sure your system meets the following requirements:

li.p: Web Browser - is a web-based application and requires a modern web browser. For the full list of supported browsers, see Browser Compatibility.
Internet Connection - A stable internet connection is required. You need access to the internal network where the server is hosted.
Email Address - A valid email address is required for account registration and notifications.
Oxygen XML Editor/Author (optional) - If you want to integrate with the Oxygen XML desktop applications, Oxygen XML Editor or Author version 26 or newer is required.
